prompt: Rewrite the following as a warm thank-you note without exaggeration: 'You watered the plants while I was away. The basil looks better than before. You also noticed the window was leaking. I appreciated the message and the towel you put there.' Aim for about 80 words.
text: Thank you for watering the plants while I was away. The basil looks noticeably better, and I’m glad you gave it some attention. I also really appreciated you spotting the leaking window and letting me know right away. Putting a towel there was thoughtful and helpful, especially since I wasn’t around to deal with it. Thanks again for taking care of those small but important things.
